change_summary: Material environmental current-state update since 21:56 CDT, without Jubilee confirmation. The NOAA NGOFS2 21Z Point Clear forecast remains shoreward across 1, 3, 6 and 12 hours at its fresh 22:48 CDT reference (+55.25, +83.06, +41.38 and +201.86 m), but the 3-hour projection is about 55% lower and the 6-hour projection about 84% lower than the previously reported 19:54 CDT-reference values (+184.37 and +259.25 m). This weakens the earlier model-guidance signal; it is not observed transport or oxygen. KBFM reported fair conditions with an east wind at 13 mph at 22:53 CDT, a fresh regional weather observation; the official Northern Mobile Bay forecast remains southeast around 5 kt becoming east, waves at or below 1 ft/light chop. USGS 02469761 and 02469762 were fresh at 22:30 CDT (3030 and 3170 ft3/s) but are the same Coffeeville river system and not additive; lag to the Eastern Shore remains unknown. All six owner cameras completed matching three-frame bursts from 23:06–23:09 CDT with no capture fault. Nighttime biology remains UNKNOWN; no flashlight, collecting or clustered-search signal was resolved. Direct Hazcams sessions at 23:31 CDT advanced across two samples about 15.3 seconds apart and were probably fresh with exact delay unknown. No material event signal was visible; neither Fairhope beach is in view. Fresh indexed searches found no credible same-day first-person Jubilee report.
